resources.string: Manage OpenVPN profiles and Cisco connections. Android allows only one active VPN connection at a time.
Select VPN mode in Settings before using these protocols. Proxy-only and root mode keep their existing Xray behavior.

Import a self-contained .ovpn file (up to 2 MiB), including its certificates and keys. External certificate files and executable scripts are not imported. Username and password are requested when required.
Cannot import this profile. Check its .ovpn format and include certificates/keys inside the file. External files, scripts or files over 2 MiB are not supported.

Add your server address and port in the connection manager. The gateway supplies username, password, group and any additional authentication prompts. Certificate warnings must be reviewed; verification is not silently disabled.
